senses.gloss:
तुड् तुड्, cl. 1. 6. P. तोडति, तुडति, तुतोड,
तोडितुम् or तुडितुम्, to tear, split, break,
cut, pull to pieces; to push; to injure, hurt or kill;
to bring near.

तुड्ड् तुड्ड्, cl. 1. P. तुड्डति, &c., to dis-
respect, disregard, contemn; [cf. rt. तूड्
and तोड्.]

तूड् तूड् (= तुड्), cl. 1. P. तूडति, &c., to
split; to slight, disrespect.
